card.name: Words just before "across"
card.fires_on: Verbs or linking words like "used", "and", or "observed" at a point where the next word is likely "across". It is seen in the antiepileptic suicidality warning and in education text.

modes.label: Verb before across
modes.description: A passive verb such as "used" or "observed" where "across" is likely to follow.

card.writes: It pushes the model to say "across" or "span" next, and away from unrelated Chinese phrases.
